subject: Personnel evidence staging request — onboarding/offboarding controls
messages:
From: Clearline SOC2 Team <soc2@clearline.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding controls evidence (personnel)

Hi Aisha,

As part of our ongoing SOC 2 evidentiary review for Clearline Financial, we need a samples package for personnel controls related to onboarding and offboarding. Could you please provide the following items by end of week?

- One redacted background-check sample (ID/SSN removed)
- Training completion report for security & privacy training for the last 12 months (machine-readable preferred)
- Evidence of access deprovisioning timeline (example of a terminated user deprovisioning log)
- A short manifest describing where live evidence lives and expected retention windows

If you have a single packaged folder or a secure link (Drive/SharePoint) that we can review, that would be ideal. Let us know if you need an NDA or any specific redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Clara Nguyen
Clearline SOC2 Team
soc2@clearline.com

---
Note: this request is limited to demonstrative samples and redacted artifacts; no live PII should be shared in unencrypted attachments.

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Clearline SOC2 Team <soc2@clearline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, VettingCo Ops <ops@vettingco.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding controls evidence (personnel)

Hi Clara — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Marissa (account lead), Dylan (HR ops), Jonas (security), and our background-check partner (VettingCo).

Action plan (proposed):
- VettingCo to provide one fully redacted sample background check and confirm redaction methodology (ops@vettingco.com).
- HR ops (Dylan) to export the onboarding training log (CSV) and a short train-the-trainer slide deck excerpt for context.
- Security (Jonas) will pull a deprovisioning runbook excerpt and an example log entry showing timestamps for access removal.
- Marissa and I will compile a manifest (xlsx) that maps each artifact to the SOC 2 control (e.g., CC6.1 / CC6.2) and include retention policies.

Please confirm the following: is a Google Drive link acceptable for delivery (we will apply folder-level encryption and a short-lived sharing window), and do you require DocuSign for any attestation?

VettingCo / Dylan / Jonas — can you target an initial drop of redacted artifacts by Tue EOD (21 May)? Marissa and I will assemble and forward to Clearline on Wed.

Thanks all — Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Head of Compliance & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: VettingCo Ops <ops@vettingco.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Clearline SOC2 Team <soc2@clearline.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding controls evidence (personnel)

Hi Aisha / Dylan,

Attached are the two items we can provide immediately: a redacted sample background check (.pdf) and an extract of our onboarding verification log (.csv). We applied the following redaction policy: remove PII fields (SSN, DOB, full address), replace names with role placeholders (e.g., "ENGINEER-123"), and annotate redaction locations with reason codes.

Attachments:
- background-check-sample-redacted.pdf (PDF, 1 page, redaction stamps included)
- onboarding-training-log.csv (CSV, headers: employee_id, role, training_id, completion_date, status)

If you need the same artifacts in an encrypted container, tell us the preferred symmetric key exchange or provide a public key. Also flag if you want us to remove any additional metadata (file timestamps).

Best,
Ravi Patel
Ops Lead, VettingCo
ops@vettingco.com
[Attachment: background-check-sample-redacted.pdf]
[Attachment: onboarding-training-log.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding controls evidence (personnel)

Thanks, Ravi — looks good from a quick scan. A few internal notes before we forward to Clearline:

- Storage: I created a short-lived Drive folder (link below). We will upload the VettingCo files plus the runbook excerpt and manifest. Folder share set to expire in 14 days.
- Manifest: I'll generate personnel-evidence-manifest.xlsx mapping artifacts to CC controls and retention columns (retention windows in months).
- Deprovisioning example: Jonas, please include a sanitized runbook excerpt and one log line showing user disabled -> keys revoked -> account archived. Aim for a single-page excerpt so reviewers can follow the timeline.
- Redactions: ensure all attachments include a redaction legend (what was removed and why). Clearline expects redaction not to remove audit trails.

Drive (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjkLmnopQrsT

I'll assemble everything Wed morning and propose we send to Clearline Wed afternoon with a short cover note and the manifest.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Personnel evidence package for Clearline Financial (staging link + manifest)

Hi Clara — thanks for the patience. We assembled a redacted sample package and a short manifest for the personnel onboarding/offboarding controls you requested. Items are staged in a secure folder (link below) and include a summary mapping to SOC 2 control IDs.

Staged artifacts (redacted or excerpted where applicable):
- background-check-sample-redacted.pdf (from VettingCo)
- onboarding-training-log.csv (CSV export showing completion status for last 12 months)
- deprovisioning-runbook-excerpt.pdf (one page, sanitized)
- personnel-evidence-manifest.xlsx (artifact-to-control mapping + retention policy)

Drive (staging, expires 2028-06-05): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjkLmnopQrsT
DocuSign (attestation request): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/eq-983274

Notes:
- VettingCo applied PII redaction and included a redaction legend.
- We did not include raw PII or unencrypted scanned IDs. If Clearline requires additional supporting logs (e.g., IAM event IDs), please specify the scope and justification and we will coordinate with Security for an audit-friendly export.

Please confirm receipt and whether you prefer a zipped package by email or a short-term sftp transfer. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want a walkthrough.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Compliance & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
